transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just having trouble focusing, I guess. It's... well, I get pulled off track pretty easily. Like, if I'm trying to fill out a job application or something, every little sound just kind of derails me. A car goes by outside, or my phone buzzes, or even just some random thought pops into my head, and... I don't know, I just end up doing something else before I even realize I stopped what I was doing.
Have you had this difficulty focusing since you were a child, or did it start more recently?

Yeah, um... since I was a kid. Even back in elementary school, I guess. Teachers were always moving my seat. I... talked out of turn a lot, I guess. And I'd forget my homework. Or if I did do it, I'd just rush through the worksheets and make careless mistakes. So, yeah... it's not a new thing.
Do you often feel restless or find it difficult to sit still, as if you're driven by a motor?

I mean... yeah, I guess so. I don't really sit still much. 

Um... even on days when I don't have work or training or anything, I'm just kind of always moving around. Like, I'll go from the kitchen, out to the garage, then over to my game setup... I just feel like I'm supposed to be doing something all the time, I guess.
